fact: INStaD's Recueil des potentiels de recherche (database position at end December 2024) states that it compiles statistics from administrative sources, such as business statistical and tax returns (DSF) and civil registers, and lists an administrative civil-registration database (Statistiques d'Etat Civil, 2007 to 2023, from commune secretaries).
title: Recueil des potentiels de recherche INStaD 2024
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INStaD)
